metadata.title: Zakon o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o lijekovima (Narodne novine 136/2025)
metadata.edition: NN 136/2025, 5 November 2025; in force the day after publication (čl. 11) · amends the Zakon o lijekovima (NN 76/13, 90/14, 100/18); čl. 226 penalties (EudraVigilance reporting under čl. 151 st. 1; prior notice of public pharmacovigilance announcements under čl. 158 st. 1) (Croatian)
metadata.legal_basis: Act of the Croatian Parliament; the text in the Narodne novine governs.
metadata.applicability: Nositelji odobrenja za stavljanje lijeka u promet (see the PV Info HALMED-HR national addendum).
